prompts.label: banner
prompts.text: Wide horizontal 16:9 layout (1200px wide) featuring a minimalist home office scene with floating productivity elements arranged in a clean grid. Include a sleek laptop floating at center-left, wireless headphones suspended mid-air, a potted succulent in a geometric planter, and a steaming coffee mug with rising steam curls. Add subtle productivity icons like a calendar, clock, and checkmark floating in the background. Use a sophisticated color palette with deep navy #1E3A8A, soft lavender #A78BFA, and mint green #10B981. The scene should feel organized and inspiring, representing the ideal remote work environment. Modern flat illustration with soft 3D-style characters and objects, combined with subtle 2D decorative elements. Use warm, vibrant pastels (teal #00A99D, coral-orange #FF6B35, sunshine yellow #FFD700). Layout must be clean and giftable, using rounded forms, balanced negative space, and minimal visual clutter. The tone should feel cheerful, light, editorial, and creative — never realistic or photorealistic. Use text only in social images. Background colors can vary within our color palette.

prompts.label: og
prompts.text: Horizontal 16:9 layout (1200px wide) featuring a premium remote work gift collection arranged in an elegant flat-lay composition. Include a rose gold #E91E63 ergonomic chair, emerald green #059669 standing desk, and sapphire blue #3B82F6 wireless headphones. Add floating 3D-style elements like a webcam with ring light, smart water bottle with hydration tracking, and meditation app icon with zen symbols. The scene should feel upscale and professional with subtle 2D productivity motifs and sparkles. Arrange items in a clean, editorial style with plenty of breathing room.
